column2: Our school team won the basketball championship for the first time.
column3: 我們學校的隊伍第一次拿下籃球冠軍。
column5: champion 冠軍 + ship 狀態：像 friendship 的 ship

column2: The class sold cookies to raise money for charity.
column3: 這個班級賣餅乾為慈善機構籌錢。
column5: charity 唸「查瑞提」，查到有人需要就伸出援手

column2: Washing the dishes is my chore after dinner.
column3: 洗碗是我晚餐後要做的家事。
column5: chore 唸「抽兒」，抽籤抽到洗碗就是今天的家事

column2: The school chorus sang beautifully at the spring concert.
column3: 學校合唱團在春季音樂會上唱得非常動聽。
column4: sing in a chorus (在合唱團唱歌)
column5: chorus 唸「闊拉斯」，大家開闊嗓子一起唱

column2: Grandpa's friend smoked a cigar on the porch every evening.
column3: 爺爺的朋友每天傍晚都在門廊抽一根雪茄。
column5: cigar 唸「西嘎」，和 cigarette 同家族但更粗長

column2: The newspaper has a daily circulation of over two million.
column3: 這份報紙每天的發行量超過兩百萬份。
column5: circ 圓圈 + ulation：報紙像圈圈一樣流傳出去

column2: She stayed calm despite the difficult circumstances.
column3: 儘管處境艱難，她仍保持冷靜。
column4: under the circumstances (在這種情況下)
column5: circum 周圍 + stance 站：站在你周圍的狀況

column2: Ancient Egypt was one of the earliest civilizations in the world.
column3: 古埃及是世界上最早的文明之一。
column5: civil 公民 + ize 化：人們組成城市社會就是文明

column2: The librarian explained the classification of books by subject.
column3: 圖書館員說明了書籍依主題的分類方式。
column5: class 班級 + ify 使：把東西分班分級

column2: Red beans and rice make a tasty combination.
column3: 紅豆和米飯是美味的組合。
column5: combine 結合，去 e 加 ation 就是組合

column2: The commander ordered the troops to rest for the night.
column3: 指揮官命令部隊休息一晚。
column5: command 命令 + er 人：下命令的人

column2: Good communication between parents and teachers helps students succeed.
column3: 家長與老師之間良好的溝通，有助於學生成功。
column5: communicate 的名詞，大家共同分享訊息

column2: He stored all his old photos on a compactdisk.
column3: 他把所有舊照片都存在一張光碟裡。
column5: compact 小巧 + disk 圓盤：小小圓圓的光碟

column2: The old dog was her faithful companion on long walks.
column3: 這隻老狗是她長途散步時忠實的伙伴。
column5: com 一起 + pan 麵包：一起吃麵包的夥伴

column2: Competition between the two shops kept prices low.
column3: 兩家商店之間的競爭讓價格一直很低。
column5: com 一起 + pete 追求：大家一起追同一個目標

column2: She beat every competitor in the swimming race.
column3: 她在游泳比賽中打敗了每一位對手。
column5: compete 競爭 + or 人：參賽的那個人

column2: Noise in the library broke my concentration.
column3: 圖書館裡的噪音打斷了我的專心。
column5: concentrate 專心：把心力集中到一個中心點

column2: There was confusion at the gate when the bell rang.
column3: 鈴聲響起時，校門口一片慌亂。
column5: con 一起 + fus 倒：全倒在一起，亂成一團

column2: Congress passed a new law to protect the rivers.
column3: 國會通過了一項保護河川的新法律。
column5: con 一起 + gress 走：大家一起走進來開會

column2: Words like because and although are conjunctions that join two clauses.
column3: because 和 although 這類的字是連接詞，用來連接兩個子句。
column5: con 一起 + junct 連：連在一起，像 junction 路口

column2: His conscience bothered him after he lied to his friend.
column3: 他對朋友說謊後，良心很不安。
column5: con 共同 + science 知道：心裡自己知道對錯

column2: The letter B is a consonant, but A is a vowel.
column3: 字母 B 是子音，而 A 是母音。
column5: con 一起 + son 聲音：得和母音一起才響

column2: The company hired a consultant to improve its website.
column3: 公司聘請了一位顧問來改善網站。
column5: consult 諮詢 + ant 人：給你意見的人

column2: The old man smiled with contentment as he watched the sunset.
column3: 老先生看著夕陽，臉上露出知足的微笑。
column5: content 滿足 + ment 名詞：心滿意足的狀態

column2: Her contribution to the science fair earned the team first prize.
column3: 她對科學展的貢獻讓團隊贏得了第一名。
column5: con 一起 + tribute 給予：大家一起付出一份

column2: Many people shop online for the convenience of home delivery.
column3: 許多人在網路上購物，圖的是宅配的方便。
column5: 便利商店就是 convenience store，帶來方便的店

column2: She sewed a bright costume for the school play.
column3: 她為學校的戲劇縫製了一套鮮豔的服裝。
column5: costume 和 custom 習俗同源，穿特定場合的裝束

column2: The student council meets every Wednesday to plan school events.
column3: 學生會每週三開會，規劃學校活動。
column5: council 是會議團體；counsel 是給人建議

column2: Pottery is a traditional craft in this mountain village.
column3: 製陶是這個山村的傳統手工藝。
column5: craft：一雙巧手慢慢做出來的手藝，像摺紙

column2: The creation of the new park took two years.
column3: 新公園的創建花了兩年的時間。
column4: the creation of jobs (創造工作機會)
column5: create 創造 + ion：創造的行動或成果

column2: Art class encourages creativity by letting students design their own posters.
column3: 美術課讓學生自己設計海報，以激發創造力。
column5: create 創造 + ivity：能創造的能力

column2: The film critic gave the movie five stars.
column3: 那位影評人給這部電影五顆星。
column5: critic 唸「克里提克」，影評劇評都出自他們

column2: Cruelty to animals is against the law in Taiwan.
column3: 在台灣，虐待動物是違法的。
column5: cruel 殘酷 + ty 名詞：殘忍的行為

column2: Curiosity led the boy to open the mysterious box.
column3: 好奇心促使男孩打開了那個神祕的盒子。
column5: curious 好奇的名詞，像小貓東張西望

column2: Red lanterns are the main decoration at Lunar New Year.
column3: 紅燈籠是農曆新年最主要的裝飾。
column5: decorate 裝飾 + ion：彩帶燈籠就是 decoration

column2: A strong defense helped our team win the final game.
column3: 強大的防守幫助我們隊贏得了決賽。
column5: defense 和 fence 籬笆同家族，築籬笆防禦

column2: The storm caused great destruction along the coast.
column3: 這場暴風雨在海岸一帶造成嚴重的破壞。
column5: de 倒下 + struct 建造：把建好的東西拆倒

column2: With great determination, she finished the marathon despite the rain.
column3: 儘管下雨，她憑著堅定的決心跑完了馬拉松。
column4: show great determination (展現堅定決心)
column5: determine 決定 + ation：下定決心不動搖

column2: Mom changed the baby's diaper before putting him to bed.
column3: 媽媽在讓寶寶上床睡覺前先幫他換了尿布。
column5: diaper 唸「呆趴」，寶寶呆呆趴著包尿布

column2: His diligence in practicing the piano finally paid off.
column3: 他勤奮練習鋼琴，終於有了回報。
column5: diligence 唸「滴里真斯」，一滴滴汗水真勤奮
